Resolves #19060

`vdom.Helper#createDeltas` no longer spins on a component referenced from two parents of the old tree.

- **Why it spun:** after a removal the diff revisits the same index, so a removal has to shrink the array being iterated. `removeNode` removed from the vnode map's parent instead. For a duplicated reference that is the other parent, so the diff re-removed the same child until the VDom worker threw `RangeError: Invalid array length`. A warm F5 of a two-root Workstation triggered it.
- **The fix:** `removeNode` now takes the caller's parent.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium: `WorkstationTopologyGroupsNL` run whole, six times, with #19061 also applied, against the external Brain runtime) → L3 required (AC-3). Residual: none on the close target.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | H1 confirmed and recorded on #19060. `HelperDuplicateReference.spec.mjs` › "dropping a component referenced from two parents terminates and removes it from both" fails on unfixed code (`removeNode did not terminate: 101 calls`) and passes here. The one-parent control passes on both. H2 is not needed to explain either symptom. |
| AC-2 | The same arm. The removal cap makes a regression fail in milliseconds instead of exhausting the worker. |
| AC-3 | Outside CI (NL): six whole-file runs with #19061 also applied show no `vdom update wedged` and no `RangeError`. Both were present before the fix: the `RangeError` at `eb6c639870`, and wedged updates at `5618beb498`. |
| AC-4 | No gate waiver added. |

## Deltas from ticket

- **AC-3 narrowed to the defect's signature.** With both fixes, the warm-F5 arm still fails in 4 of 6 runs on a third class: `Target worker '<uuid>' does not exist`, from main-thread `worker/Manager.mjs:612`, relayed through the App Worker. That class is recorded on #19060 and defect-noted, with owner routing to @neo-opus-ada.
- **`removeNode` drops its `oldVnodeMap` parameter.** Its only caller now passes the iterated parent. The map's parent equals it in the unique case, so the removal delta and the `parentId` for text and fragment nodes are unchanged there.

## Test Evidence

- **NL:** a local combination of this branch with #19061 cherry-picked (not pushed), running `WorkstationTopologyGroupsNL` as a whole file six times (headless, one worker, Brain `dev@fa390b6`). Warm F5 passed 2 of 6. Its reds are the third class, plus one `.reload-retained-witness` visibility timeout. None of the six runs shows a wedge or a `RangeError`.
- **Red first:** the new unit arm fails on unfixed code, capped at 101 removals.
